dict.string: Gauntlet uses Bluetooth to send your wrist movement, taps and Digital Crown turns to the Gauntlet app on your Mac, so your arm can move the pointer.
Gauntlet reads the watch's gyroscope and accelerometer to turn the way you move your forearm into pointer movement, clicks and scrolling on your Mac.
Gauntlet shows your live heart rate on the watch and in the Mac app while a session is running. Nothing is read from your Health history.
Gauntlet starts a workout session only so the watch keeps streaming motion when you lower your wrist. The workout is discarded when you end the session and is never saved to Health.
Gauntlet sends what you say to June, the assistant in the Gauntlet app on your Mac, only while June is on. Your Mac listens for "Hey June"; nothing is sent anywhere before you say it.
